label: Small Biotech IND Starter — IB Change Summary
description: IB change summary for Edition 3, incorporating new Phase 1 safety data.

inputs.changes_summary:
• Updated Section 5 (Clinical Experience) with 6-month interim safety data from Study LT-001
• Added new pharmacokinetic data from dose cohorts 3-5
• Revised Section 4 (Nonclinical) to include 13-week chronic toxicology study results
• Updated adverse event tables with Grade ≥3 events observed to date
inputs.new_safety_data: In the dose-escalation phase (cohorts 1-5, n=24), treatment-emergent adverse events included cytokine release syndrome (CRS) in 8/24 (33%) patients (Grade 1-2: 6, Grade 3: 2). Neurotoxicity (ICANS) occurred in 3/24 (12.5%) patients (all Grade 1). No Grade 4/5 events or treatment-related deaths.
inputs.updated_efficacy: Preliminary efficacy signals: Overall response rate 42% (10/24), including 3 complete responses (12.5%) and 7 partial responses (29%). Median duration of response not yet reached (median follow-up: 4.2 months).
inputs.revised_dosing: Step-up dosing regimen refined based on CRS mitigation: Cycle 1 Day 1: 0.5 mg; Day 8: 5 mg; Day 15: 50 mg (target dose). Pre-medication with dexamethasone 8 mg recommended for all doses in Cycle 1.
inputs.impact_assessment: do not alter the overall favorable benefit-risk profile for the target population
inputs.benefit_risk_status: favorable, supporting continued investigation in expanded cohorts
inputs.prepared_by: Dr. James Park, VP Clinical Development
